notable_absence.predicate: availableSince / a dedicated cross-product minimum-version predicate
notable_absence.finding: This page carries the most detailed cross-product compatibility matrices found so far in this round - Table 2 (Sync Gateway x Couchbase Server, by version, with a separate Bidirectional Active-Active XDCR column) and Table 3 (Sync Gateway x Couchbase Lite, by version). Both express 'X requires at least version Y of the other product' as a two-dimensional grid of yes/no image cells, not as prose sentences with a stable subject-predicate-object shape - so no relation was extracted from the grids themselves (only the one explicit prose sentence, 'Couchbase Lite 4.x is only compatible with Sync Gateway 4.0 and later,' was directly quotable). The registry has no predicate that cleanly expresses a minimum-required-version-of-a-DIFFERENT-product relationship (availableSince expresses a feature's own version of introduction, not a cross-product compatibility floor) - the same missing-vocabulary gap noted in prior rounds for cardinality and version facts, here recurring for cross-product compatibility matrices specifically.

cross_component_finding: Within Sync Gateway itself, this page distinguishes three separate RBAC-gated surfaces needing three separate Couchbase Server roles: Server access proper (role:sync-gateway, the product's own service identity), the Admin REST API (role:full-administrator), and the Metrics REST API (role:ro-admin or role:bucket-full-access) - confirming and extending sgw:admin-rest-api and sgw:metrics-rest-api's existing registry descriptions ('gated through the same Server-RBAC-reused identity system') with the concrete recommended role names, which no prior extraction had captured.
cross_product_finding: Table 3's warning is a direct, explicit three-way compatibility statement: 'Couchbase Lite 4.x is only compatible with Sync Gateway 4.0 and later... due to version vector architecture changes.' This a genuine cross-product (Sync Gateway <-> Couchbase Lite) compatibility floor tied to an internal architecture change (sgw:version-vector, already promoted from a prior round) - the matrices as a whole (Tables 2 and 3) are this page's entire reason for existing, mapping Sync Gateway versions against both Couchbase Server and Couchbase Lite version ranges side by side.
